description: Search enforcement reports and recall actions across drugs, food, and devices. With stage=true, call openfda_dataframe_describe for the staged columns, then openfda_dataframe_query for SQL.

canvas_id.description: canvas_id from an earlier staged call to openfda_search_* or openfda_lookup_ndc: stages this call onto that canvas too (as stage=true does), so its tables can be joined.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with no skip and the same search, sort, and endpoint as that call; other inputs may change.

endpoint.description: Report type: enforcement reports, or recall (devices only).

fields.description: Dotted record paths to keep on each record, e.g. ["recalling_firm", "reason_for_recall"], plus its identity key (recall_number, product_res_number). Any record path works (openfda_describe_fields lists searchable ones); a path through an array covers every element. Use it when page_bytes flags an oversized record; with stage=true only the inline page is projected.

include.description: Paths left out of each record by default, to return: code_info, more_code_info on device enforcement; code_info, openfda.k_number, openfda.fei_number, openfda.registration_number on device recall. Name one whole, or a path beneath one for that field alone; with fields, entries join the projection. A search clause on a left-out path also returns it.

limit.description: Records per page. Default and cap by category and endpoint: drug or food enforcement 25 (cap 1000), device enforcement 10 (cap 125), device recall 10 (cap 50); a larger value returns at most that cap and says so.

search.description: openFDA search query, e.g. classification:"Class I" (or "Class II", "Class III"), recalling_firm:"pfizer", reason_for_recall:"undeclared allergen". Omit to browse newest first. A "+" between clauses reads as a space; inside a quoted phrase it is a literal plus.

skip.description: Records to skip, at most 25000; to read past that, follow next_cursor from skip 0.

sort.description: A field path with :asc or :desc (any letter case; :ascending and :descending also work), several comma-separated, e.g. report_date:desc,status.exact:asc. With neither search nor sort, records come newest first by report_date:desc (event_date_initiated:desc on the device recall endpoint). A search without sort returns openFDA's index order, not relevance.

stage.description: Also stage the matched set on a DataCanvas for SQL: openfda_dataframe_describe lists its columns, then openfda_dataframe_query runs the SQL. Staging is bounded (staged_rows says how many rows landed); for a distribution over the whole match, use openfda_count_values.

name: openfda_search_recalls

canvas_id.description: Canvas id of the staged set: pass to openfda_dataframe_describe, openfda_dataframe_query, or a later staged search.

canvas_table.description: Staged table name: openfda_dataframe_describe lists its columns, then use it in openfda_dataframe_query.

effectiveQuery.description: Search filter applied to the recall query, as submitted to openFDA

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `recall_endpoint_non_device`: The recall endpoint was requested for a non-device category. `limit_above_cap`: limit exceeds the cap of the endpoint this call selects, on a deployment that rejects rather than clamps it. `canvas_disabled`: Staging was requested (stage=true or a canvas_id) but DataCanvas is disabled. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id is well-formed but names no active canvas — expired or never minted. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: canvas_id was omitted and the active canvas cap is already reached. `rate_limited`: The openFDA daily or per-minute request limit is exceeded. `upstream_error`: The openFDA API returned a 5xx server error. `malformed_search`: search leaves a double quote, parenthesis, or range bracket unclosed, ends on a backslash, or holds a character openFDA refuses. `query_error`: The search query was rejected by openFDA (malformed field name, invalid syntax). `pagination_limit_reached`: skip exceeds the 25000 record pagination ceiling. `invalid_cursor`: cursor does not decode, belongs to another endpoint, search, or sort, or comes with skip above 0, stage, or canvas_id. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limit.description: Page size applied: limit, the endpoint default, or the cap when limit exceeded it. The last page of a match holds fewer records.

totalUnverified.description: True on an empty page at skip > 0 whose total could not be confirmed: total 0 then does not rule out records — re-call with skip=0.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; present on a page read at skip 0 or by cursor when more records follow.

notice.description: Guidance for this page: empty result, limit clamp, end of a cursor walk, fields projection, oversized record, staging, paths left out by default. Absent when nothing needs saying.

omitted_fields.description: Paths left out of each record by default and their bytes on this page; name one in include to return it.

items.description: A left-out path and its bytes.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes left out under the path on this page.

path.description: Dotted path; array elements share one path.

page_bytes.description: UTF-8 size of results; present only when a record exceeds 24000 bytes, with page_largest_fields.

page_largest_fields.description: The largest record's biggest fields, largest first, beside page_bytes. Leave them out with fields.

bytes.description: UTF-8 bytes, summed across array elements.

path.description: Dotted path; array elements share one path (patient.drug.openfda covers every drug).

projected_fields.description: Paths each record was projected to, present only with fields; a field missing from a record was projected away, not absent upstream.

results.description: Enforcement records (every category) carry recall_number, classification, status, voluntary_mandated, recalling_firm, product_description, reason_for_recall, distribution_pattern, report_date. Device recall records carry product_res_number, recall_status, res_event_number, root_cause_description, and the firm, product, reason, and distribution fields, but no hazard classification.

spilled.description: True when this call staged its matched set; see canvas_id.

staged_rows.description: Rows written to the canvas table; below meta.total, the table holds only the first staged_rows records.

totalResults.description: Total matching recall/enforcement records in the dataset

truncated.description: True when staging stopped short of meta.total (size budget or the 25000-row ceiling); narrow the search for the whole set.

title: Openfda Search Recalls
